jobs.title: Director, HR Transformation, Systems and Analytics
jobs.description:
This is a hybrid position based out of our 243 Consumers Rd location in North York, with 4 days per week in office and 1 day remote.

Lifemark Health Group (LHG) is a market leader in customized healthcare solutions. With over 20 years of service excellence, LHG is one of the largest, most trusted, and most comprehensive providers in Canada. As a national healthcare company, LHG employs over 5,000 highly trained clinicians, medical experts and team members in almost 400 locations coast-to-coast and continues to grow both organically as well as through acquisitions. Lifemark was acquired by Loblaw Companies on May 10, 2022.

The Opportunity:

We are seeking a strategic, collaborative, and results-oriented Director, HR Transformation, Systems and Analytics to lead the evolution of Lifemark's HR operating model, technology capabilities, and people analytics function.

Reporting to the Vice President, People & Culture, this role will provide strategic leadership across HR transformation, systems, process optimization, data governance, and workforce analytics. The Director will be responsible for developing and executing a roadmap that strengthens HR operational effectiveness, establishes scalable processes and controls, improves data quality, and enables more informed people and business decisions.

A key priority will be leading Lifemark's readiness for a future Workday implementation, ensuring that HR processes, data, governance, systems, and organizational capabilities are positioned for successful transformation. The role will also oversee the effectiveness and continuous improvement of existing HR platforms while identifying opportunities to leverage technology, automation, and responsible AI to improve efficiency and the employee and manager experience.

Working closely with People & Culture leadership, Operations, Finance, Payroll, IT, Talent Acquisition, and Enterprise partners, the Director will translate business priorities into practical, sustainable solutions, lead cross-functional initiatives, and build the capabilities required to support Lifemark's continued growth and evolution.

Key Responsibilities:

HR Transformation, Strategy & Operating Model

Develop and execute a comprehensive HR transformation strategy and roadmap aligned with organizational priorities, business growth, and the evolving needs of the People & Culture function.
Lead the assessment and optimization of Lifemark's HR operating model, identifying opportunities to strengthen service delivery, accountability, governance, operational efficiency, and employee experience.
Establish consistent, scalable, and well-controlled HR processes across core employee lifecycle activities, including recruitment, onboarding, employee changes, position management, organizational changes, compensation-related workflows, and offboarding.
Lead current-state process assessments to identify gaps, duplication, manual workarounds, inefficiencies, and operational or compliance risks.
Oversee the development and implementation of standardized processes, operating procedures, governance frameworks, controls, and accountability structures.
Establish mechanisms to monitor process effectiveness, compliance, and adherence to established controls.
Identify and prioritize opportunities for process simplification, automation, and continuous improvement across People & Culture.
Lead transformation initiatives associated with organizational growth, acquisitions, integration activities, and evolving business requirements.
Develop business cases, implementation plans, success measures, and executive recommendations to support transformation investments and priorities.

HR Systems Strategy & Workday Readiness

Provide strategic and functional leadership for Lifemark's HR systems landscape, ensuring technology capabilities support business requirements, HR operations, data integrity, and employee and manager experience.
Develop and maintain an HR technology roadmap that balances current operational requirements, system optimization, future-state capabilities, and long-term transformation priorities.
Lead the development and execution of Lifemark's Workday readiness roadmap, establishing clear milestones, accountabilities, dependencies, risks, and decision points.
Assess organizational readiness across HR processes, data quality, governance, integrations, reporting, security roles, permissions, change impacts, and operating model requirements.
Partner with Enterprise HRIS, IT, Payroll, Finance, and other stakeholders to align HR technology priorities, integration requirements, and future-state system design.
Oversee the prioritization, planning, testing, and implementation of enhancements to existing HR systems, including configuration changes, workflow improvements, reporting capabilities, and process automation.
Establish appropriate governance and controls for HR system administration, access management, data maintenance, system changes, and issue resolution.
Identify and address foundational process, data, and governance gaps that may impact the success of future HR technology implementations.
Lead or support technology assessments, vendor engagement, business case development, solution design, and implementation planning as required.
Ensure effective change management, documentation, training, and stakeholder readiness for HR system and technology initiatives.

People Analytics, Reporting & Data Governance

Develop and lead Lifemark's people analytics and reporting strategy, enabling reliable, meaningful, and actionable workforce insights to support business and HR decision-making.
Establish consistent HR metrics, reporting standards, data definitions, and governance practices across the organization.
Oversee the development and continuous improvement of HR dashboards, scorecards, and management reporting related to workforce trends, headcount, turnover, recruitment, organizational structures, and other key people metrics.
Partner with People & Culture, Finance, Operations, and business leaders to identify reporting requirements and translate workforce data into actionable insights.
Lead initiatives to improve HR data quality, completeness, accuracy, consistency, and accessibility across systems and processes.
Establish data governance frameworks, ownership, validation processes, and controls to support the integrity and reliability of people data.
Identify opportunities to strengthen workforce planning, trend analysis, forecasting, and organizational decision-making through enhanced reporting and analytics.
Support the development of self-service reporting capabilities and standardized reporting tools to improve accessibility and reduce manual effort.
Ensure appropriate privacy, confidentiality, and data protection practices are embedded into HR reporting and analytics processes.
Present workforce insights, trends, risks, and recommendations to People & Culture leadership and business stakeholders.

Process Optimization, Automation & Responsible AI

Lead the identification and prioritization of opportunities to simplify, standardize, and automate HR processes to improve efficiency, scalability, and service delivery.
Partner with Talent Acquisition to assess and optimize recruitment processes, from requisition intake through candidate selection, offer management, onboarding handoff, and reporting.
Evaluate opportunities to leverage automation, AI, and emerging technologies to improve HR operations, recruitment effectiveness, reporting, and employee and manager experiences.
Assess potential AI applications in recruitment and HR operations, including workflow automation, candidate communications, scheduling, reporting, document creation, and knowledge management.
Partner with Legal, Privacy, IT, Enterprise teams, and People & Culture leadership to ensure technology and AI recommendations align with organizational policies, ethical standards, privacy requirements, and applicable legislation.
Lead the implementation of approved process improvements, including change management, stakeholder engagement, training, and measurement of outcomes.
Establish performance indicators and continuous improvement mechanisms to evaluate operational efficiency, process effectiveness, and transformation benefits.

Leadership, Governance & Stakeholder Partnership

Provide strategic leadership across HR transformation, systems, and people analytics, ensuring alignment with People & Culture priorities and broader organizational objectives.
Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing team, establishing clear priorities, accountability, performance expectations, and development opportunities.
Build team capability and promote a culture of collaboration, innovation, continuous improvement, and strong internal customer service.
Establish effective governance structures, project oversight, and prioritization processes to ensure the successful delivery of strategic and operational initiatives.
Manage competing priorities, resources, project dependencies, and risks to ensure timely and high-quality execution.
Serve as a trusted advisor to the Vice President, People & Culture and HR leadership team on transformation opportunities, HR technology, workforce analytics, and operational effectiveness.
Build strong partnerships with Operations, Finance, Payroll, IT, Legal, Talent Acquisition, and Enterprise teams to ensure coordinated and sustainable solutions.
Lead cross-functional working groups, stakeholder discussions, and executive presentations to drive alignment, resolve issues, and support decision-making.
Champion change management and adoption strategies to ensure successful implementation of new processes, technologies, and ways of working.

What we're looking for:

University degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Information Systems, Organizational Development, or a related discipline; an equivalent combination of education and experience will be considered.
Minimum of eight (8) to ten (10) years of progressive experience in HR transformation, HR operations, HR systems, people analytics, or related HR leadership roles, including demonstrated experience leading complex initiatives and teams.
Proven experience developing and executing HR transformation strategies, technology roadmaps, process improvement initiatives, and organizational change programs.
Strong understanding of HR operating models, employee lifecycle processes, governance, internal controls, and HR operational best practices.
Demonstrated experience with HR systems and technology, including system optimization, configuration oversight, integrations, data governance, and reporting.
Experience leading or preparing for a large-scale HRIS implementation; Workday experience is strongly preferred.
Strong knowledge of HR data management, workforce analytics, reporting frameworks, dashboards, and HR metrics, with the ability to translate complex data into meaningful business insights.
Experience leading process mapping, process redesign, standardization, control development, and operational improvement initiatives.
Demonstrated experience identifying and implementing automation and technology-enabled process improvements.
Familiarity with AI applications in HR and recruitment, including responsible AI, privacy, compliance, and governance considerations.
Proven people leadership experience, with the ability to coach, develop, and lead teams through change and transformation.
Strong project and program management capabilities, including roadmap development, resource planning, risk management, stakeholder engagement, and executive reporting.
Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and strategic thinking skills, with the ability to balance long-term transformation priorities with day-to-day operational requirements.

jobs.title: Directeur(trice) Principal(e) de la Technologie et de l'Innovation | Director of Software Technology and Innovation
jobs.description:
Directeur(trice) Principal(e) de la Technologie et de l'Innovation

À propos de Crowe BGK

Depuis 75 ans, Crowe BGK S.E.N.C.R.L. est un chef de file de confiance en matière de services de comptabilité et de conseil au Canada. Notre équipe compte plus de 250 professionnels qui servent nos clients à partir de nos bureaux de Montréal et d’Ottawa. Nous offrons des services d’audit, de fiscalité, de conseil et de consultation, aidant les particuliers et les sociétés privées à relever des défis complexes. Nous sommes fiers d’avoir été nommés parmi les 100 meilleurs employeurs de PME au Canada et parmi les meilleurs employeurs de Montréal, car nous croyons qu’il est essentiel de créer un milieu de travail où les gens se sentent soutenus, valorisés et inspirés à progresser.

Nous sommes à la recherche d’un(e) Directeur(trice) Principal(e) de la Technologie et de l'Innovation

expérimenté(e) et pratique pour aider Crowe BGK à maintenir un environnement technologique fiable et à faire progresser l’utilisation des logiciels à l’échelle du cabinet. La personne retenue combinera une compréhension des processus d’affaires, une discipline opérationnelle et une expertise technologique afin d’améliorer le service à la clientèle, l’efficacité, l’évolutivité et l’expérience employé.

Vous Serez Responsable De

Stratégie et gouvernance des logiciels d’entreprise

Élaborer et maintenir la feuille de route pluriannuelle des applications du cabinet, l’inventaire des logiciels, le modèle de propriété et la gouvernance pour la sélection, les accès, les changements, les intégrations, les renouvellements et le retrait.
Identifier les lacunes en matière de capacités, les dédoublements, les outils sous-utilisés ou non pris en charge ainsi que les occasions émergentes; conseiller le ou la COFO, les associé(e)s et la direction sur les priorités, les investissements, les compromis, la normalisation et les coûts.

Amélioration des processus d’affaires et innovation

Analyser et repenser les processus dans les services à la clientèle et les fonctions corporatives, en mobilisant les parties prenantes afin de résoudre les irritants, les lacunes de contrôle, le travail à refaire, les problèmes de données et les besoins non satisfaits avant l’automatisation.
Utiliser les données et les commentaires pour prioriser les améliorations à forte valeur ajoutée et évaluer les flux de travail, l’automatisation, l’analytique, l’intelligence artificielle et les technologies émergentes en tenant compte de la confidentialité, de la qualité, des contrôles et de la supervision humaine appropriés.

Évaluation des logiciels et analyses de rentabilité

Traduire les besoins d’affaires en exigences mesurables sur les plans fonctionnel, technique, des données, de la sécurité, de l’intégration, des contrôles, du service et des utilisateurs; diriger les démonstrations, les projets pilotes, les vérifications de références, les grilles d’évaluation, la diligence raisonnable des fournisseurs et la comparaison objective des risques et des solutions de rechange.
Préparer et présenter des analyses de rentabilité pour les décisions d’aller de l’avant ou non, couvrant le coût total de possession, le rendement du capital investi, les échéanciers, les ressources, l’incidence du changement, la formation, l’atténuation des risques, le soutien et les coûts de sortie; soutenir les négociations commerciales et contractuelles.

Gouvernance et responsabilité de la mise en œuvre

Agir à titre de responsable imputable du volet affaires et technologie, en partenariat avec le ou la gestionnaire de projet attitré(e), afin de définir la portée, les résultats, le budget, les ressources, la gouvernance, les jalons, les droits décisionnels, les risques, les communications et les mesures de succès.
Coordonner les parties prenantes et veiller à la conception des processus, à la configuration, aux intégrations, à la conversion des données, aux essais, aux contrôles, à la formation, à la mise en production, au soutien, à la préparation, à la stabilisation, à l’adoption et à la réalisation des bénéfices; faire remonter les lacunes importantes et maintenir la visibilité auprès de la direction.

Gestion du portefeuille, des fournisseurs, des données et des risques

Gérer les budgets logiciels, les licences, l’utilisation, les renouvellements, les fournisseurs, les contrats, les niveaux de service, les indicateurs du portefeuille, la rationalisation et le retrait des solutions.
Collaborer avec les ressources en TI, cybersécurité, protection de la vie privée, affaires juridiques et gestion des risques afin d’encadrer les intégrations, les données, les contrôles d’accès, la continuité des activités, les risques liés aux tiers, l’intelligence artificielle et l’automatisation.

Leadership du changement et mobilisation des parties prenantes

Établir des relations de confiance avec les associé(e)s, les dirigeant(e)s, le personnel, les fournisseurs et les prestataires de services; diriger les employé(e)s attitré(e)s et les équipes interfonctionnelles en assurant une responsabilisation claire et une forte orientation vers le service.
Diriger les communications, la formation, l’adoption, la documentation, le soutien et la propriété des applications; développer des ambassadeurs internes, contribuer au plan d’affaires du cabinet et tenir le ou la COFO ainsi que les parties prenantes informés.

Autorité et responsabilité

Responsable du portefeuille de logiciels, de la feuille de route des applications, des normes de gouvernance et de la direction des équipes de mise en œuvre des TI et des processus dans le cadre de la stratégie et des budgets approuvés; peut exiger les examens appropriés en matière d’affaires, de sécurité, de protection de la vie privée, d’intégration, de contrôle et de mise en œuvre.
Recommande la sélection, le séquencement, le renouvellement, l’expansion, la consolidation ou le retrait des logiciels; peut suspendre ou faire remonter les préoccupations non résolues et est responsable de la qualité des recommandations, de la gouvernance de la mise en œuvre, de l’adoption, de la stabilisation et des bénéfices approuvés.

Mesures de succès

Gérer un inventaire à jour des logiciels, une propriété claire, une gouvernance rigoureuse, une feuille de route approuvée, des analyses de rentabilité crédibles et des dépenses contrôlées.
Réaliser les mises en œuvre avec une gouvernance, une préparation, des contrôles, une adoption et un soutien durable efficaces, ainsi qu’avec la réalisation des bénéfices approuvés.
Obtenir des améliorations mesurables en matière d’efficacité, de capacité, de qualité, de fiabilité des données, d’expérience employé et client, de performance des fournisseurs, de gestion des risques et de confiance des parties prenantes.

Les Qualifications Qui Comptent

Baccalauréat en systèmes d’information, administration des affaires, comptabilité, finance, informatique, génie ou dans un domaine connexe; une combinaison équivalente de formation et d’expérience sera considérée.
Sept années ou plus d’expérience progressive en logiciels, systèmes d’affaires, amélioration des processus, transformation technologique, gestion de produits ou gestion de programmes, dont au moins trois années dans un rôle de leadership ou de responsabilité à l’échelle de l’entreprise.
Une expérience dans un cabinet comptable ou un autre environnement de services professionnels est privilégiée, avec une compréhension des décisions dirigées par les associé(e)s, du service à la clientèle soumis à des échéanciers, de la confidentialité et du changement entre les groupes de pratique.
Succès démontré dans la direction d’évaluations de logiciels, d’analyses de rentabilité, de sélection de fournisseurs et de mise en œuvre de solutions SaaS à l’échelle du cabinet ou de l’entreprise.
Expérience pratique de la cartographie et de la refonte des processus, des exigences, des essais, de la formation, de la gestion du changement et de la réalisation des bénéfices.

Vous Pouvez Compter Sur Nous Pour

Une rémunération compétitive
Un modèle de travail hybride flexible
Des assurances collectives complètes dès le premier jour d’emploi pour soutenir votre bien-être global
Des vacances généreuses et 8 journées personnelles pour responsabilités familiales
Des fermetures du cabinet pendant les Fêtes pour décrocher pleinement
Des vendredis d’été avec fermeture hâtive durant la saison estivale
Stationnement gratuit sur place ou remboursement du transport en commun
Une allocation annuelle mieux-être pour soutenir la santé physique et mentale
Une allocation pour l’aménagement du bureau à domicile afin d’assurer un environnement confortable et productif
Une culture de bureau dynamique et accueillante, où les chiens sont les bienvenus et où l’énergie est au rendez-vous. Entre les 5 à 7 animés, les cours de spinning hebdomadaires, les ateliers de peinture en équipe, les soirées quiz et karaoké, il y a toujours une activité rassembleuse. Sans oublier notre Camp Crowe, une expérience estivale unique remplie d’activités amusantes qui favorisent la camaraderie et créent des souvenirs mémorables

Si vous cherchez un endroit où vos idées comptent et où votre carrière peut s'épanouir, postulez dès aujourd'hui!

Cultivez votre curiosité. Inspirez votre esprit. Façonnez votre carrière.

Nous maintenons un environnement de travail inclusif et offrant des chances égales afin que chaque professionnel de Crowe BGK puisse réaliser son potentiel d'évolution. Nous considérons tous les candidats qualifiés pour un emploi sans distinction de race, de couleur, de religion, de sexe, d'orientation sexuelle, d'identité de genre, d'origine nationale, d'âge, d'état matrimonial, de handicap, de statut d'ancien combattant protégé ou de tout autre facteur protégé par la loi.

Nous remercions tous les candidats pour leur intérêt et nous ne contacterons que ceux que nous souhaitons poursuivre.

Director of Software Technology and Innovation

About Crowe BGK

For 75 years, Crowe BGK LLP has been a trusted leader in accounting and advisory services in Canada. We are a team of 250+ professionals serving clients from our Montreal and Ottawa offices. We provide audit, tax, advisory, and consulting services, helping individuals and private companies navigate complex challenges. We’re proud to be named one of Canada’s Top 100 SME Employers and one of Montreal’s Top Employers, because we believe in creating a workplace where people feel supported, valued, and inspired to grow.

We’re looking for an experienced, hands-on Director of Software Technology and Innovation

to help Crowe BGK maintain a reliable technology environment and advance the use of software across the firm. The successful candidate will combine business process insight, operational discipline, and technology expertise to improve client service, efficiency, scalability, and the employee experience.

You Will Be Accountable For

Enterprise Software Strategy and Governance

Develop and maintain the firm's multi-year application roadmap, software inventory, ownership model, and governance for selection, access, changes, integrations, renewals, and retirement.
Identify capability gaps, duplication, underused or unsupported tools, and emerging opportunities; advise the COFO, partners, and leadership on priorities, investments, trade-offs, standardization, and cost.

Business Process Improvement and Innovation

Analyze and redesign processes across client service and corporate functions, engaging stakeholders to address pain points, control gaps, rework, data issues, and unmet needs before automation.
Use data and feedback to prioritize high-value improvements and evaluate workflow, automation, analytics, artificial intelligence, and emerging technologies with appropriate confidentiality, quality, controls, and human oversight.

Software Evaluation and Business Cases

Translate business needs into measurable functional, technical, data, security, integration, control, service, and use

Job Description

Title:
Director, Finance (CSM)

Id:
21596

Type:
FullTime

Location:
Bolton, ON

At Husky TechnologiesTM, our success is based on your success. Our ability to keep our customers in the lead is based on building the strongest team possible.

Husky TechnologiesTM has a strong foundation built on innovation, close customer relationships and a unique culture and values. We are dedicated to offering our customers the highest quality products and services and are looking for people with the inspiration and talent to develop with us as we pursue our ambitious growth strategy. We are a leader in developing state-of-the-art technology and it is this technology base that uniquely positions us to serve customers who seek differentiation through solutions that provide speed, flexibility and maximum productivity. This capability is at the core of our mission and competitive strategy.

Husky TechnologiesTM offers a wealth of opportunity for personal growth and development. Most importantly, Husky Technologies TM offers an opportunity to work with – and be challenged by – a team of great people. Our success is possible because of the creativity, intelligence and passion of our people around the world and their desire to lead change. At the same time, we are not afraid to expect a lot and strive for leadership in all of our key markets. We are a company taking on new challenges and for the right people this means exceptional career development opportunities, the chance to be part of a team that is the best in the world at what we do and the experience that comes from working in an environment that demands constant transformation and innovation.

Husky TechnologiesTM is an exciting company with tremendous potential. We have a great team and great expectations. If you are attracted to bold goals, believe in uncompromising honesty, support mutual respect, care about environmental responsibility, have a passion for excellence and a desire to make a positive contribution – then we want you to join the Husky TechnologiesTM team!

The Finance Director serves as a strategic business partner to the Leadership Team in support of Husky’s Global Service Business and Customer Success Management strategy. This role provides leadership for financial planning, forecasting, performance analysis, governance, and decision support to drive profitable growth, improve operational performance, and strengthen financial visibility across service revenue streams, including field service, contracts, parts, and other aftermarket offerings. The Finance Director is expected to influence strategic decisions, lead transformation initiatives, and build a high-performing finance capability that enables the business to scale effectively.

Key Responsibilities

Financial Planning & Forecasting

Lead the annual budget, quarterly forecast, and long-range planning processes for the service business.
Develop robust revenue, margin, cost, and headcount forecasts based on operational and commercial drivers.
Translate business strategies into financial plans with clear assumptions, risks, and opportunities.
Support scenario planning and sensitivity analysis for service growth, pricing, labor utilization, and investment decisions.

Performance Management & Analysis

Deliver timely and accurate monthly financial reporting and variance analysis for service revenue, gross margin, SG&A, and operating income.
Analyze business performance by region, product line, customer segment, channel, and service offering.
Monitor and explain key drivers of performance, including labor utilization, absorption, contract profitability, attach rates, response times, and service productivity.
Provide actionable insights and recommendations to improve growth, profitability, and working capital performance.

Business Partnering

Serve as the senior finance partner to service leadership, operations, commercial teams, and Customer Success leaders, providing insight and challenge on strategic priorities, business performance, and investment decisions.
Lead financial evaluation of pricing strategies, contract renewals, service program design, and capital or operating investments to support sustainable growth and margin expansion.
Provide proactive challenge and decision support to business leaders by identifying risks, opportunities, and trade-offs across growth, productivity, service delivery, and resource allocation.
Lead cross-functional evaluation of new service offerings, business models, and transformation initiatives that improve service coverage, utilization, fulfillment, cost efficiency, and customer value.
Sponsor finance and business transformation initiatives across Finance and Customer Success Management, including enhancements to processes, reporting, operating metrics, and decision frameworks that support growth, profitability, and scalability.

Management Reporting & KPI Development

Develop and enhance dashboards, reporting tools, and KPIs that improve transparency and decision-making.
Standardize definitions and reporting for critical service metrics across the organization.
Improve reporting automation and self-service analytics capabilities where possible.
Present clear financial results and business insights to senior leadership

Process Improvement & Governance

Strengthen forecasting accuracy, reporting discipline, and financial controls within the service business.
Drive continuous improvement in FP&A processes, planning models, and reporting frameworks.
Ensure alignment with corporate finance requirements, accounting policies, and internal controls
Support month-end close and planning processes in partnership with accounting and finance teams.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field required.
CPA, CMA, CFA, or MBA preferred.
10+ years of progressive experience in FP&A, finance business partnering, commercial finance, or operational finance, including leadership responsibility.
Experience in a service, aftermarket, field service, maintenance, or contract-based business strongly preferred.
Strong financial modeling, forecasting, and business analysis skills.
Advanced proficiency in Excel and experience with ERP and planning/reporting systems.
Executive presence with strong communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills, and the ability to influence senior leaders across functions and regions.
Proven ability to work cross-functionally in a fast-paced, performance-driven environment

Preferred Experience In a Service Business

Understanding of service revenue models such as time and materials, service contracts, preventive maintenance, subscriptions, and parts/service bundles.
Experience analyzing operational KPIs such as technician utilization, service efficiency, contract margins, backlog, renewal rates, and service attach rates.
Familiarity with pricing strategy, labor productivity, installed base analytics, and customer lifecycle economics

Core Competencies

Strategic leadership
Financial and commercial acumen
Analytical rigor
Executive business partnership
Influence and executive communication
Problem solving
Process improvement
Results orientation and a bias for action

Team Development

Build and lead a high-performing finance team with strong capability in financial analysis, strategic thinking, business partnership, and change leadership.
Lead, coach, and develop team members, including succession planning, capability building, and development of future finance leaders.

Financial Leadership

Provide consistent, timely, accurate, and decision-oriented financial reporting for the service business, with greater automation and self-service access to insights where possible

Husky TechnologiesTM offers a competitive compensation and benefits package and excellent opportunities for growth and advancement. We are committed to equal employment opportunity and respect, value and welcome diversity in our workplace. Husky Technologies TM also values being a great place to work and strives to maintain a safe workplace. Accordingly, Husky TechnologiesTM conditions all offers of employment on satisfactory completion of background checks.

Husky TechnologiesTM is committed to developing inclusive, barrier-free selection processes and work environments. jobs.title: Head of Strategy & Operations
jobs.description:
🚀 Why Midnite?

Midnite is a next-generation sports betting and gaming platform built for a new wave of players.

We combine sharp product thinking, bold brand, and fast execution to create experiences that feel modern, intuitive, and built for how people actually play today.

Over 400,000 players have already made the move, and we’re only just getting started.

We’re a high-performance team operating at pace. High ownership. Constant iteration. No hiding behind processes. We move quickly, test relentlessly, and turn ambitious ideas into real impact. If you’re driven, creative, and thrive in fast-moving environments where you can shape meaningful outcomes - keep reading.

Not your grandad’s bookie.

👀 The Role

Head of Strategy & Operations

Location:
Toronto - in office

Vacancy status:
This posting is for a new role and is not an existing vacancy.

Midnite is preparing to launch and scale its Canadian business. We are looking for a Head of Strategy & Operations to partner directly with the Canada GM, drive the launch program, build the operating model, and become the steward of the Canada strategy, P&L, priorities, and budget once we go live. This leader will ensure that priorities are clear and that cross-functional teams and plans are aligned toward a common outcome.

As a member of the Canadian leadership team, the Head of S&O will support the GM in launching, operating, and scaling the business.
